item.title: Blit 0.2.22
item.description: A cleaner two-pane window: each pane is its own card, the active one shows where F5 and F6 send, headers say what a folder is on (Drive, NAS, Seedbox), and footers show free space. Every file is one line, dates shorten to fit, and columns always fit the pane. The full HUD is about 40% shorter and opens only when there's room.
